2115911909920891390.en_summary: SNDK Sandisk CEO: Higher NAND prices are pressuring entry-level devices. Units were down this year and will be slightly down next year in low single digits. These two calendar quarters are the trough of the year-over-year compares, the most negative.
2115911909920891390.zh_summary: Sandisk CEO表示，較高的NAND價格正在對入門級設備造成壓力。今年單位出貨量下降，明年將略有下降（低個位數）。目前這兩個日曆季度是同比比較的低谷，最為負面。

2115911407141257383.en_summary: The Big 4 have now revealed their quarterly CapEx spending with a combined total surpassing $200B: AMZN ~$77B, GOOGL ~$51B, MSFT ~$39B, META ~$34B.
2115911407141257383.zh_summary: 四大科技公司已披露季度資本支出，合計超過2000億美元：亞馬遜約770億、谷歌約510億、微軟約390億、Meta約340億。

2115911399348326559.en_summary: RDDT CEO: Reddit plans to transition toward a logged-in-only platform to improve engagement, ad targeting, and data protection. Moving to primarily logged-in ensures best experience, more ad signals, higher engagement, protects valuable data corpus, and adapts to regulations. Quoted note on search referral traffic down meaningfully in Q3.
2115911399348326559.zh_summary: Reddit CEO表示，Reddit計劃轉向僅限登入平台，以改善參與度、廣告定位和數據保護。主要轉向登入將確保最佳體驗、更多廣告信號、更高參與度，保護寶貴數據語料庫，並適應法規。引用了第三季搜索推薦流量顯著下降的說明。

2115911189721194768.en_summary: RDDT Reddit CEO: Our search referral traffic was down meaningfully in Q3, with the decline accelerating later in the quarter. Biggest impact on logged-out and web traffic, some flows through to logged-in and app traffic as search is a common re-engagement source. Quoted further decline details.
2115911189721194768.zh_summary: Reddit CEO表示，第三季搜索推薦流量顯著下降，季度後期加速。最大影響在未登入和網頁流量，部分影響傳導至已登入和應用流量，因為搜索是用戶再參與的常見來源。引用了進一步下降細節。

ticker_notes.RDDT: 搜索推薦流量第三季顯著下降且加速，影響DAU再參與

2115910883335614861.en_summary: RDDT Reddit CEO: Search referrals declined sharply in Q3. During October, search traffic has dropped by more than 1 million referrals on average per week. If this rate continues, total DAUQs could fall in Q4 by a low double-digit percentage from current base of 130 million DAUQs.
2115910883335614861.zh_summary: Reddit CEO表示，第三季搜索推薦急劇下降。十月期間，搜索流量平均每週下降超過100萬次推薦。如果此趨勢持續，第四季總DAUQ可能從目前1.3億的基數下降低兩位數百分比。
